summary: You and Invardia support can now see that secrets are stored safely and that updates keep running.

new.title: Key Vault checks in Get started
new.text: Get started now checks every night that your Key Vault is protected against purging and that every secret is kept in it. The check shows a count, never a secret.

new.title: Stalled updates are noticed
new.text: Invardia support now sees when your updater last ran and what it did, so an installation that stopped updating is noticed.
